messages:
jess: Heads-up — mid-sprint release freeze starts today at 18:00 UTC. This is targeted: no new global promotions for model or quant-plugin artifacts until 06:00 UTC tomorrow. Canaries continue in the canary region only. Please read the short rollout plan below and call out blockers now. :warning:

omar: Quick q — does this block emergency hotfix promos?

jess: Good question. Emergency hotfixes are allowed but must go through the expedited review flow (ping @kim + 2 approvers). Document the reason in the PR/chan thread and tag `release:emergency`. We want to avoid accidental wide promos.

kim: SRE note: during freeze we'll set autoscaler min-replicas to current floor for dedicated pools and enable conservative batching on ingress. That reduces risk of noisy scaling events. I'll flip the flags at 17:50 UTC.

lucy: Runtime teams — if you have KV cache migration or quantized model swaps scheduled, postpone global swap. Safe to push to canary nodes for validation, but do not promote to global.

jess: Canary fallback plan (short):
- If canary latency regresses > 15% or error rate > 2% for 5m, auto-fallback to previous variant.
- If canary fails healthchecks, ops-bot will block promos and notify #eng-oncall.
- Manual rollback still OK but follow the emergency flow.

jess: Canary config snippet we applied to the release controller:```yaml
canary:
  regions: ["us-west-2-canary"]
  promotion_policy: manual
  auto_fallback: true
  fallback_thresholds:
    latency_pct: 15
    error_pct: 2
```

omar: Copy. Will cascade the pause to the model onboarding pipeline. Anything for Dedicated customers?

kim: Dedicated: we'll set a temporary alert threshold so TSEs get paged if 10% of host pools dip below health for 10m. Ops will coordinate customer comms if we need to extend freeze.

deploy-bot: Attempted promo of `quant-plugin@v0.9.1` at 18:03 UTC — PROMOTION BLOCKED by policy: mid-sprint freeze.

lucy: Also: if you depend on dedupe/cache priming jobs, please tag them `non-blocking` or reschedule. We saw a spike during last freeze window.

jess: Action items:
- All teams: audit scheduled promos between 18:00-06:00 UTC and either cancel or mark `release:freeze` (small PR comment).
- @kim: flip autoscaler + alerts (17:50 UTC).
- @lucy: confirm canary fallback config applied to all controllers (now).
- Release coordinators: hold any cross-region promotions until 06:00 UTC.

jess: If you hit a hard blocker for a critical customer, call the emergency flow. Otherwise assume freeze holds. Thanks — will post a short post-freeze summary tomorrow morning. :pray:
